blurb: The Hemlocks is a long standing establishment that opened in 1954 as a gas station, café and motel. Over the years, and with various owners, the café evolved into a thriving restaurant, much loved by the local community. Word of the delicious food and welcoming atmosphere spread into Canada and Montana. The RV Park was added and this local business became a regional destination.
